messages.subject: Simple suggestion for documentation
parts:
Hope this is the right place to post this for shiny dev team to read it...:
You could improve the documentation by using a little more of seealso in your documentation: 
e.g.: would be great if ?selectInput referenced to numericInput and other kinds of input and vice versa. 

keep up the great work! 

matt

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Simple suggestion for documentation
parts: For such a request, the help pages in RStudio are very convenient : open the help by running help(pa=shiny) and then type "input" in the "Find in this topic" cell.
